ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Food Assistance Programs
ideas.description: An investigation into the financial transactions and oversight of Minnesota's food assistance programs, including the Feeding Our Future scheme.
questions: What are the financial transactions involved in the Feeding Our Future scheme?
How effective is the oversight of Minnesota's food assistance programs?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story could uncover potential widespread fraud in the state's food assistance programs, and that it would be an important investigation for the public to know about.
